annotation: The participant leaned forward abruptly, their eyebrows shot up, and their jaw dropped.
The participant raised their eyebrows, narrowed their eyes, and extended their hands forward, and made a crossing gesture with their arms, indicating disapproval.
The participant lunged forward with an arched back and their right arm outstretched.
The participant raised both hands to their temples, smoothing their eyebrows upwards, and bent forward slightly.
